title: nothing published in 14d was accepted: 22 measured post(s), 0 like(s), 0 comment(s), 0 save(s)
evidence: 25 post(s) published in the last 14d, 22 with insights collected; totals over the measured set: likes=0 comments=0 saves=0 reach=71 (mean reach 3.2/post). The harness is producing normally -- renders complete, posts land, the queue holds at target -- so every machine-level check stays green while the RESULT is zero. This is the acceptance counter for the 2026-09-28 GO/PIVOT/KILL gate; a flat engagement read there is this condition, not a starved pipeline. Account reach attribution, newest measured snapshot (09-24 16:00): non-follower=0 follower=5 total=5. Instagram's account insights answer `reach` with `breakdown=follow_type`, so this is the platform's own split, not an inference from a per-post sum: non-follower=0 means nothing outside the follower list was shown these posts at all -- a DISTRIBUTION ceiling rather than a content problem, and the lever the gate's pivot candidate names. Independent witness: Instagram's own account-level counter (accounts_engaged, period=day) read 0 across 6 measured day(s) in this window, so the zero is stated by the platform rather than produced by our collection. Self-closes when a published post is engaged with (any like/comment/save in the window) -- that predicate stays on the per-post columns the gate reads, so a platform counter that disagrees is reported here and never closes it silently.

2026-09-24 10:4xZ ops-triage: THE PIVOT'S OWN EVIDENCE WAS UNWATCHED -- now guarded, and verified against real data. The whole discovery pivot ('non-follower reach is a measured zero, so no content lever can move followers') rests on growth_snapshots.non_follower_reach, and that path is BEST-EFFORT BY DESIGN: MetricsCollector swallows a failed insights call, logs one warning and stores NULL, so the measurement can stop running with no error anywhere. check_insights_stale does NOT cover it (posts.insights_updated_at is a different endpoint and producer), latest_discovery_attribution() returns the newest NON-NULL row with NO age bound -- so this item's own evidence text would keep asserting non-follower=0 from a row that no longer describes the present -- and the client's own note says a breakdown that never reconciles with the account total 'is how a silently broken breakdown would show itself', yet no check compared the parts to the whole. FIXED in the repo: new check_discovery_attribution + pure attribution_verdict, firing on (a) newest attribution older than 6h (snapshots are hourly), (b) reach answered WITHOUT a follow_type breakdown = unmeasured, never zero, (c) follower+non-follower != reach_total. Staleness is judged FIRST so an old row cannot be reported as live. VERIFIED: selftest 646/0 (was 636; 10 new cases incl. never-measured-is-not-a-defect, right-at-bound, stale-beats-content); checks-audit 57 checks 0 raised 0 unreadable (was 56); and the check is not vacuous -- the live row (nf|fl|total = 0|5|5) reads quiet while the SAME row aged 7h returns warn and fl+1 returns the non-reconcile warn. DECISION, unchanged and now guarded: the arm stays SEQUENCED after the 2026-10-05 13:00Z read (the only missing piece is the rail wiring; a reel publishes with no photo, so it stays out of GateRead#cohort_size by construction), its success metric is non_follower_reach>0 -- the exact number this check now proves is still being taken -- and no levers, renders, GPU claims or posts were touched by this pass. Item stays open as the gate's continuously-tracked acceptance counter; self-closes on the first engaged published post.

2026-09-24 11:4xZ ops-triage: THE CONDITION WAS CROSS-CHECKED AGAINST THE PLATFORM, and one hypothesis is now CLOSED. Both remaining explanations for '0 engagement at full production rate' -- (a) a distribution failure, (b) our content was REMOVED and we are measuring posts that no longer exist -- had the same local signature: provider_post_id is written once at publish time and never re-read, so a taken-down post keeps counting as posted in the queue runway, the 14-day acceptance counter and the per-pillar engagement read. Measured read-only against the Graph API this pass: (1) the account node reports media_count=224 against 149 posts this app published with a provider id (a platform inventory LARGER than ours, so nothing has been lost); (2) the newest 10 published posts are all still retrievable (10/10, not_retrievable=0) and the platform's own like_count/comments_count agree with our columns exactly (0/0 on every one, matching db_likes/db_comments 0). VERDICT: (b) is refuted -- the inventory is intact and the counters are real -- so the zero is a genuine DISTRIBUTION outcome, which is what the pre-registered pivot candidate names. The hand-run check is now MACHINERY rather than a story: growth_snapshots.media_count is collected on every hourly snapshot (same account-node call as followers_count, no extra round trip, NULL when unanswered so an unmeasured inventory can never read as 'nothing was removed') and a new probe check platform-media-removed fires on a strict decrease below the recorded peak -- publishing can only INCREASE media_count, so a decrease is removal stated by the platform rather than inferred from our bookkeeping. VERIFIED: live snapshot recorded media_count=224 at 2026-09-24T11:32Z; selftest 653 assertions 0 failures (+7 new cases: unmeasured-stays-silent, equal-is-not-a-shrink, grew, shrink, shrink-many); checks-audit 58 checks 0 raised 0 unreadable (was 57) with the new check quiet on the live row (224|224); non-vacuity proven by driving it with a doctored result -- live 224|224 -> quiet, 224|223 -> warn naming the decrease and how to attribute it, unmeasured 'na' -> quiet, truncated row -> quiet (no crash); rspec 24 examples 0 failures (metrics collector + Instagram client). No decision changes: the reel arm stays sequenced after the 10-05 read and no lever was pulled -- this only removes a rival explanation for the number the pivot is built on.
